title: I Built Mimu Because Even Taking Notes Is Too Much Work
why_read: A simple personal hackathon project for voice note-taking with local AI organization, pleasant but technically unremarkable.
analysis: Mimu is a voice note app that transcribes speech with Whisper in the browser and then uses a small local Gemma model to auto-generate titles, tags, and formatting for the note. It's a straightforward integration of existing open models rather than a novel technique, built as a Hacktoberfest challenge submission. The appeal is purely as a lightweight personal productivity tool, with little new technical content for experienced practitioners to learn from.
